author: AtditC
body:
Hello, Atdit here.

The user smitdalt made many spam posts with useless content. I can only show you his recent posts, snd you'll see he has been warned but he's still posting useless things which don't make sense.

Evidence: https://avicus.net/smitdaIt#posts

You will probably not see a rule which is being broken, but in my opinion, it is considered trolling.

Greetings,
Atdit

replies.body:
Hi,
We will investigate this issue, and look through his posts carefully. We also need to conduct an IP check as he claims his account was compromised.

Thanks.

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
Hey Atdit,

We'll look out for him in the future. He is on very infrequently, but I do understand what you mean. However, I do not believe it is enough to deserve a punishment. 

Feel free to send in another report if he continues at a later time.

Regards,
-PokerFace
